front.title: Client ID Metadata Document Software Statement Lifecycle

abstract.t: This specification defines how a Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD) software statement, as defined in a companion specification, is withdrawn, superseded, and replaced after an authorization server has admitted or registered a client on it. That specification evaluates a statement when a grant is opened, not when it is refreshed. Under this specification, an issuer can withdraw a statement before it expires. Once an authorization server accepts a later statement, the issuer's earlier statements about the same software are superseded there for new grants and registrations, within the applicable tenant. When a grant is refreshed, the authorization server requires a later statement in place of one that has been withdrawn, and this specification recommends the same for one that has expired. A profile of Token Status List provides withdrawal, and an optional Shared Signals Framework event prompts authorization servers to check a statement's status.
